summary: evidence-gc's cap_records goes from 20,000 to 45,000 records, about twice the live set measured on 2026-10-29 once per-crate rust-tests keys were kept; the retention file may carry an optional reason string, and says why

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. The cap only decides when GC alerts (exit 3); it never deletes anything live.

compatibility.detail: evidence-gc reads the retention file and its own code from main, so both change together.
